item.text: The Corruption and Crime Commission investigated an arrest in Northbridge, examining force, a move on order and the treatment of the arrested person.
item.support: The Commission's investigation was not confined to the use of force.

item.text: The Commission accepted that the arrest was lawful but considered the neck restraint excessive and formed an opinion of serious misconduct against the arresting officer.
item.support: The Commission has formed an opinion of serious misconduct against S/C Valleekanthan.

item.text: The Commission considered another officer's move on order unlawful and formed an opinion of reviewable police action.
item.support: Issuing the order in such circumstance is reviewable police action, as it is action that is contrary to law.

item.text: The Commission also identified risks involving medical care, the length of detention and inaccurate custody records.
item.support: the length of time for detention of an arrested person, and the accuracy of recordkeeping by police officers.

item.text: The Commission emphasised that a serious misconduct opinion did not determine guilt of a criminal or disciplinary offence.
item.support: An opinion that serious misconduct has occurred is not, and is not to be taken as, a finding or opinion
